_meta.description: Deterministic validation split for DrishtiGIS UAVPal training
_meta.split_strategy: Spatially distributed holdout: 4 tiles from the 18 official training tiles. 2 from the western end of row 00 (cols 00, 03) and 2 from the eastern end of row 00 (cols 21, 22). This avoids spatial leakage while maintaining geographic spread.
_meta.note: Official test tiles are NEVER used for training or validation.
